scripts.//pull: Uses the version of docu-notion pinned in package.json/yarn.lock, so CI and local pulls always agree. Avoid going back to an unpinned `npx @sillsdev/docu-notion`: that silently follows the npm 'latest' tag, so a docu-notion release can change our generated markdown without any commit here. The `--silent` is load-bearing: without it yarn echoes the resolved command line, which prints the Notion token in plain text (GitHub Actions masks registered secrets, but a local terminal does not). Resolving docu-notion through its declared bin, rather than a hard-coded ./node_modules/.../dist/index.js path, keeps this working if a future release moves that file.
scripts.//pull:docusaurus-v2: --docusaurus-v2 keeps docu-notion emitting the Docusaurus v2 markdown forms ({#id} heading ids, :::caution). Docusaurus 3 renders those correctly via markdown.mdx1Compat. This is deliberate: switching to the v3 forms would change ~331 heading source strings and drop their fr/es/pt/hi translations in Crowdin, for no functional gain. See README.
scripts.//serve: Needed, for example, to test the search functionality locally
scripts.//migrate-i18n-to-v3: One-time migration of the Crowdin-supplied translations to Docusaurus v3 markdown syntax. See scripts/migrate-i18n-to-docusaurus-v3.cjs. Add --check to see what it would do without writing.
scripts.//pretranslate: used to re-apply translations when files are renamed or reorganized
scripts.crowdin:sync: crowdin upload sources --delete-obsolete && crowdin download -l es-ES -l fr -l pt-BR -l hi
scripts.crowdin:sync:dryrun: crowdin upload sources --dryrun --delete-obsolete && crowdin download --dryrun -l es-ES -l fr -l pt-BR -l hi
scripts.crowdin:download: crowdin download -l es-ES -l fr -l pt-BR -l hi
